observations: Photo 0: Front view of a smartphone with a live screen showing apps and a purple-red gradient wallpaper. The phone is held in a hand, with a stylus pen visible beside it. A watermark 'POSTED ON JI ALBERT NWULI' is overlaid. The screen appears to have a faint vertical line on the right edge, visible as a pinkish glow.

Photo 1: The phone's boot screen is shown, displaying 'SAMSUNG Galaxy Note20 5G' and 'Powered by android'. The screen has a vertical pinkish line running down the right edge, clearly visible against the black background.

Photo 2: Back view of the phone, showing a bronze/gold gradient finish. The camera module has three lenses and a flash. The Samsung logo is visible at the bottom. The phone appears to have minor smudges and fingerprints, but no major scratches or dents are visible. The same watermark is present.

claims.claim: Very premium used Samsung Galaxy Note 20 5G 256 GB Mystic Bronze
claims.evidence: The model is confirmed from photo 1, but the storage capacity (256 GB) and color (Mystic Bronze) are not visible in any photo. The 'premium' claim is subjective and cannot be verified remotely.
Photo 1 clearly shows a vertical pinkish line running down the right edge of the screen. Photo 0 also shows a faint line in the same position.

The seller claims 'everything' works, but no functional tests (e.g., camera, charging, speakers, S Pen) are shown. The screen line may affect functionality, but no proof of other features is provided.

risks.risk: Screen damage or malfunction due to the visible vertical line
risks.proof: A close-up video or photo of the screen under different lighting conditions, showing if the line is a dead pixel, burn-in, or hardware fault.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a defective screen, which reduces value significantly

risks.risk: Storage capacity is not 256 GB as claimed
risks.proof: A screenshot of the phone's settings showing 'Storage' details, or a photo of the box or original packaging.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown storage, which may be less than 256 GB, reducing value

risks.risk: Battery health or performance issues not visible in photos
risks.proof: A video showing battery percentage over time during use, or a screenshot of battery health from settings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown battery condition, which may be degraded

risks.risk: S Pen not included or not working
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the S Pen being removed from the phone and used to write or draw on the screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as S Pen possibly missing or non-functional, reducing value

proof_requests: A close-up video or photo of the screen under different lighting to confirm the nature of the line.
A screenshot of the phone's settings showing storage capacity and battery health.
A photo or video of the S Pen being used with the phone.
A photo of the original box or packaging, if available.
response.reason: The model is confirmed, but critical claims like storage capacity, screen condition beyond the visible line, and functionality of key features (S Pen, battery, camera) are unverified. The screen line is a major defect that must be assessed further. Without proof of these, a reliable price cannot be determined.
